title: CI writing gate: one scope, every run
summary: The writing gate in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` stops choosing between a `changed` and an `all` scope. The `writing_scope` workflow_dispatch input, the base-ref and push-before diffing, and the `fetch-depth: 0` checkout are all removed; the gate now runs `git ls-files '*.md'` on every trigger and checks every tracked Markdown file. The manual dispatch and the every-second-day schedule are kept only to cover runs where no change touches Markdown, and the empty-selection notice now means 'repository has no Markdown' rather than 'this scope selected none'.

lanes.subtitle: GitHub event sources
lanes.summary: The events that start a CI run. The change narrows what these triggers have to carry: no scope input, no base ref.

lanes.subtitle: ci.yml jobs and steps
lanes.summary: The jobs and steps of the workflow. The writing gate is the step this change rewrites.

lanes.subtitle: ubuntu-latest checkout and git

nodes.label: pull_request
nodes.subtitle: on: pull_request
nodes.summary: A pull request event still starts the workflow. It no longer supplies a base ref to the writing gate, because the gate no longer diffs against one.

nodes.label: push to main
nodes.subtitle: on: push branches [main]
nodes.summary: A push to main still starts the workflow. The `github.event.before` sha is no longer read by the writing gate.

nodes.label: workflow_dispatch
nodes.subtitle: manual run
nodes.summary: Manual dispatch survives, but its `writing_scope` choice input is gone. A manual run now behaves exactly like every other run: check all tracked Markdown.

nodes.label: schedule
nodes.subtitle: cron 0 19 */2 * *
nodes.summary: The every-second-day schedule is kept, now described as covering runs where no change touches Markdown rather than as the only `all`-scope run.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions workflow
nodes.summary: The workflow file itself. Its trigger block, checkout step and writing-gate step are all edited by this change.

nodes.label: writing gate job
nodes.subtitle: runs-on: ubuntu-latest
nodes.summary: The job that builds osf and checks the writing. Its checkout loses `fetch-depth: 0` and its check step loses the scope-selection shell.

nodes.label: Look for a Rust workspace
nodes.subtitle: id: detect
nodes.summary: Detects whether the repository has a Rust workspace and exposes `present` to later steps. Untouched, but it still gates the osf build.

nodes.label: cargo build --release --bin osf
nodes.subtitle: if: steps.detect.outputs.present == 'true'
nodes.summary: Builds the osf binary that performs the writing check. Unchanged; the gate still depends on it when a workspace is present.

nodes.label: Check the writing
nodes.subtitle: git ls-files '*.md'
nodes.summary: The rewritten step. It drops the SCOPE, BASE_REF and PUSH_BEFORE environment variables and the three-branch shell that chose between them, leaving a single `git ls-files '*.md'` listing.

nodes.label: actions/checkout
nodes.subtitle: pinned sha, no fetch-depth
nodes.summary: The checkout step loses its `fetch-depth: 0` input. The runner now gets a shallow clone, which is sufficient because nothing diffs against a base commit any more.

nodes.label: working tree
nodes.subtitle: shallow clone of the repo
nodes.summary: The checked-out tree the gate reads. It is now shallow, and it is the only source of the Markdown list.

nodes.label: git ls-files '*.md'
nodes.subtitle: enumerate tracked Markdown
nodes.summary: The single command that now produces the file list. It replaces the `git fetch` plus `git diff --name-only` branches that computed a changed-file set.

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: --bin osf
nodes.summary: The binary that performs the writing check. Unchanged, but it is now invoked against the full Markdown corpus on every run.

nodes.label: tracked Markdown
nodes.subtitle: every *.md in the repo
nodes.summary: The set of files the gate reads. It grows from 'what this change touches' to 'every tracked Markdown file' on pull requests and pushes.

nodes.label: empty-selection notice
nodes.subtitle: ::notice::
nodes.summary: The early exit when the file list is empty. Its message changes from 'this scope selects no Markdown' to 'this repository has no Markdown', matching the fact that there is no longer a scope to select.

edges.label: starts run
edges.summary: A pull request still starts the workflow; it no longer carries a base ref into the gate.

edges.label: starts run
edges.summary: A push to main still starts the workflow; the before-sha is no longer consumed.

edges.label: no scope input
edges.summary: Manual dispatch still starts the workflow, but the `writing_scope` input that used to travel with it is removed.

edges.label: starts run
edges.summary: The schedule still starts the workflow; its role is now to cover runs where no change touches Markdown.
The workflow defines the writing gate job.
The job runs the workspace-detection step first.
The job builds osf when a Rust workspace is present.
The job runs the rewritten check step, which no longer branches on scope.
The job checks out the repository, now without full history.

edges.label: shallow clone
edges.summary: Checkout produces a shallow working tree instead of a full-history one.

edges.label: enumerate
edges.summary: The check step now calls a single `git ls-files '*.md'` to build the file list.

edges.label: tracked paths
edges.summary: The shallow working tree is the only input to the enumeration; no base commit is consulted.

edges.label: every *.md
edges.summary: The enumeration now yields every tracked Markdown file rather than a changed subset.

edges.label: full corpus
edges.summary: The gate hands the full Markdown corpus to osf on every run.

edges.label: if empty
edges.summary: An empty corpus still short-circuits the gate, now with a message about the repository rather than the scope.

flows.title: Writing gate run after the change
flows.summary: Every trigger now takes the same path: check out shallow, enumerate all tracked Markdown, hand it to osf. The scope decision that used to sit between the trigger and the file list is gone.

messages.label: start job
messages.note: Any of pull_request, push, workflow_dispatch or schedule starts the same job.

messages.label: shallow working tree
messages.note: `fetch-depth: 0` is removed, so the tree has no base history to diff against.

messages.label: git ls-files '*.md'
messages.note: One command replaces the scope branch, the `git fetch origin $BASE_REF` and the two `git diff --name-only` variants.

messages.label: every tracked *.md
messages.note: The list is the whole corpus, not the changed subset.

messages.label: check all Markdown
messages.note: A rule change can now flag a file the pull request does not touch, which is the stated reason for the change.

messages.label: findings
messages.note: Findings still fail the step; only the input set changed.

views.title: CI pipeline around the writing gate
views.summary: The workflow, its triggers, the runner it executes on and the gate it drives. The writing gate step and the checkout are the changed pieces; the surrounding jobs are context.

views.title: Inside the writing gate
views.summary: The steps of the writing gate job and the file list they produce, showing where the scope branch used to sit.
